name: room-remote-s1
description: Discover and control Sonos S1 speakers over the local network.

interface.longDescription: Discover Sonos S1 speakers on your local network from the desktop app. See rooms and groups, check what is playing, browse the queue, resume or pause playback, skip tracks, and adjust an individual room’s volume or mute setting. Requires Python 3.9 or newer and access to the speaker network. An independent community plugin.
defaultPrompt: Set the kitchen speaker to 20 percent.

prompts: Find my S1 rooms and show which ones are grouped.
Show the first tracks in the kitchen queue.

publication.release_notes: Adds public installation and support links, a licensed speaker icon, and noncommercial licensing terms.
